description: This Python module provides a utility function `get_supabase_client` to initialize and retrieve a Supabase client based on environment variables. The function checks if `SUPABASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` are set and returns a client object or None if not configured. The module serves as a stub for future expansion where actual client creation can be implemented.

methods.name: Optional[object] get_supabase_client()
methods.description: Retrieves a Supabase client if configuration environment variables are set; otherwise returns None.
